AR344
Archaeological  Science
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
An investigation of the principles and techniques of physics, chemistry, materials science and data management and manipulation as they are applied to archaeological goals of survey and prospection, chronology building, as well as artifact and numerical analysis.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
AR101
,
AR102
.
Exclusions
AR244.
